subject: integration
name: Google
summary: A pointer to Google Search, a Web2 search service. Text typed in the address bar opens https://www.google.com/search?q=<text> in the tab, so Google's own servers and code answer and see the text and the connection's IP address; nothing checks the results. With search suggestions on (off by default, never in a private window) the text typed so far also goes to suggestqueries.google.com, with no cookie or referrer. Level 1, not 2: what it shows is Google's pages, not content Orivon pins. Judged here by its publisher.
